# mistershell_sensor_source (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell sensor_source by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_sensor_source" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_sensor_source" "by_name" {
  name = "sensor-source"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.
